question: What claim about the measure and origin of this teaching must hold if it is said to be a Kaula teaching of ten crore measure and supremely arisen?
premises: It is of ten crore measure.
It is described as supremely arisen.
inference: This Kaula teaching is presented as supremely arisen and vast in measure to the extent of ten crores.
uncertainties: The sense of pramāṇa here may be textual extent or numerical measure and is not explicit.
plain_english: Indeed, this Kaula teaching, supremely arisen, is of ten crore measure.
